```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true

prices <- open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  collect()
metadata <- open_dataset("data/coin_metadata.parquet") |>
  collect()
categories <- open_dataset("data/categories.parquet") |>
  collect()

crypto <- prices |>
  left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  left_join(select(categories, -description), by = "category_id") |>
  mutate(date = ymd(date_raw))
```

```{r}
crypto |>
  group_by(date, category_name) |>
  summarise(cat_mcap = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    category_name = fct_reorder(category_name, cat_mcap, .fun = median, .desc = TRUE)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = cat_mcap, fill = category_name)) +
  geom_area(position = "fill") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma", end = 0.9) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = as.Date("2022-05-07"), xmax = as.Date("2022-05-12"),
    ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = 0.25, fill = "black"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = as.Date("2022-11-08"), xmax = as.Date("2022-11-11"),
    ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = 0.25, fill = "black"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = as.Date(c("2022-05-09", "2022-11-09")),
    linetype = "dashed", color = "white", linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = as.Date("2022-04-15"), y = 0.93,
    label = "Luna/UST\ncrash", hjust = 1, size = 3, color = "white", fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = as.Date("2022-12-01"), y = 0.93,
    label = "FTX\ncollapse", hjust = 0, size = 3, color = "white", fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Share of total market cap",
    fill = "Category",
    title = "Crypto market cap share by category, 2018–2026",
    subtitle = "Bitcoin gained share as smart-contract platforms shrank and stablecoins grew",
    caption = "Source: Coin Metrics Community Data (CC BY 4.0)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
